name: UCREST
recent: UCREST 正在推进私募配售，并已获 Bursa Securities 批准将完成期限延长 6 个月至 2027 年 4 月 23 日。公司在 2025 年 11 月 12 日举行的第 28 届常年股东大会和特别股东大会上通过了所有决议，包括设立员工认股计划（ESOS）。此外，公司近期有多项董事委员会成员变动。
notable: Bursa Securities approved a 6-month extension for UCREST to complete its private placement, from 24 October 2026 to 23 April 2027.。
All resolutions were passed at the 28th AGM, including directors' fees, re-election of directors, and re-appointment of auditors.。
All resolutions were passed at the EGM, including the establishment of an ESOS of up to 30% of issued shares and allocation of ESOS options to directors.。
risks: The private placement remains outstanding and has been extended to 23 April 2027, which may result in dilution upon completion.。
The ESOS of up to 30% of issued shares could dilute existing shareholders if options are exercised.。

recent_en: UCREST is proceeding with its private placement and has obtained Bursa Securities' approval for a 6-month extension to complete it by 23 April 2027. The company passed all resolutions at its 28th AGM and EGM held on 12 November 2025, including the establishment of an employees share option scheme (ESOS). There have also been several changes in board committee memberships recently.
notable_en: Bursa Securities approved a 6-month extension for UCREST to complete its private placement, from 24 October 2026 to 23 April 2027.
All resolutions were passed at the 28th AGM, including directors' fees, re-election of directors, and re-appointment of auditors.
All resolutions were passed at the EGM, including the establishment of an ESOS of up to 30% of issued shares and allocation of ESOS options to directors.
risks_en: The private placement remains outstanding and has been extended to 23 April 2027, which may result in dilution upon completion.
The ESOS of up to 30% of issued shares could dilute existing shareholders if options are exercised.
